languages.name: English (Original)
languages.plain:
This was a triumph
I'm making a note here, huge success
It's hard to overstate my satisfaction
Aperture Science
We do what we must because we can
For the good of all of us
Except the ones who are dead
But there's no sense crying over every mistake
You just keep on trying 'til you run out of cake
And the science gets done
And you make a neat gun
For the people who are still alive
I'm not even angry
I'm being so sincere right now
Even though you broke my heart and killed me
And tore me to pieces
And threw every piece into a fire
As they burned, it hurt because I was so happy for you
Now these points of data make a beautiful line
And we're out of beta, we're releasing on time
So I'm glad I got burned, think of all the things we learned
For the people who are still alive
Go ahead and leave me
I think I prefer to stay inside
Maybe you'll find someone else to help you
Maybe Black Mesa!
That was a joke, haha, fat chance
Anyway, this cake is great
It's so delicious and moist
Look at me still talking when there's science to do
When I look up there, it makes me glad I'm not you
I've experiments to run
There is research to be done
On the people who are still alive
Believe me, I am still alive
I'm doing science, and I'm still alive
I feel fantastic, and I'm still alive
While you're dying, I'll be still alive
And when you're dead I will be still alive
Still alive, still alive

languages.plain:
Este fue un triunfo
Estoy tomando nota aquí, gran éxito.
Es difícil exagerar mi satisfacción.
Ciencia de la apertura
Hacemos lo que debemos porque podemos.
Por el bien de todos nosotros
Excepto los que están muertos.
Pero no tiene sentido llorar por cada error
Sigue intentándolo hasta que te quedes sin pastel
Y la ciencia se hace
Y haces un arma genial
Para las personas que todavía están vivas
ni siquiera estoy enojado
Estoy siendo tan sincero ahora mismo.
Aunque rompiste mi corazón y me mataste
Y me hizo pedazos
Y arrojó cada pieza al fuego

Creo que prefiero quedarme dentro.
Tal vez encuentres a alguien más que te ayude.
¡Quizás Mesa Negra!

De todos modos, esta tarta es genial.

Y cuando estés muerto yo seguiré vivo
Todavía vivo, todavía vivo
